outcome: time to return to normal activities
cohort: 298 patients undergoing TLH between January 2012 and December 2018 at Shaheed Suhrawardy Medical College and Hospital, of whom 286 (96%) had benign conditions and 12 (4%) had malignant conditions.
finding: TLH is a safe and acceptable alternative to standard hysterectomy for various gynecological indications, with a mean operating time decreasing from 130 to 60 minutes, a mean hospital stay of 2 days, and return to normal activities within 2 weeks.
